channel.title: AI GridWatch — North Carolina data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for North Carolina, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Davie County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year data center moratorium

item.title: Gates County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, unanimous; covers all data center and crypto mining applications. Preventative — prompted by two inquiries from a data center consulting firm. County water system has been under its own moratorium since 2018

item.title: Brevard: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 90-day moratorium while city staff draft UDO text amendments. Term may have lapsed — confirm current status with the city

item.title: Clay County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban — Ordinance No. 01.08.2026 prohibits the establishment, construction, expansion, or operation of commercial data centers in all zoning districts

item.title: Canton: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause, unanimous; covers data centers, crypto mining, and server farms. ~200 residents attended. Prompted by inquiries about the former Evergreen Packaging paper mill site

item.title: Chatham County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause on data centers, data processing, and crypto mining in unincorporated areas; expires Feb 11, 2027 or when new zoning regulations are adopted. A developer has sued, claiming it blocks a planned 750 MW project

item.title: Kings Mountain: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 182-day (6-month) pause, passed 5-2. Planning department studying setbacks/screening, utility capacity, and noise standards

item.title: Boone: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, unanimous (5-0); covers data centers and crypto mining within town limits. Nearly 100 residents attended in support. Council pursuing permanent regulations

item.title: Apex: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause, unanimous; effective Apr 28. Covers data centers, data processing, and crypto mining. Followed withdrawal of the 250 MW 'New Hill Digital Campus' proposal

item.title: Orange County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, 6-0; covers large-scale data centers including AI, crypto mining, and data processing. No large-scale data centers currently in the county

item.title: Rowan County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, unanimous; prohibits zoning or rezoning for data center purposes. Does NOT apply to the existing Long Ferry Road project (Edged Energy). 100+ residents attended; 5,200+ petition signatures

item.title: Swain County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause, unanimous. Public hearing drew 140 residents and 34 speakers in Bryson City. Two citizen advisory committees formed to study impacts

item.title: Watauga County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, unanimous; suspends new data center construction county-wide. County collaborating with utilities, conservation groups, and NC DEQ on permanent regulations. Separate from the Town of Boone moratorium (Mar 23)

item.title: Madison County: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data processing facilities including crypto mining and large server farms, passed unanimously. Would have expired ~Jun 2024; no extension or replacement ordinance found. Confirm current status with the county before citing as active

item.title: Clyde: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban — Board of Aldermen voted unanimously to amend the zoning ordinance to prohibit data centers in all zoning districts. Proactive; no specific proposal was pending

item.title: Charlotte: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 180-day moratorium on data centers over 100,000 sq ft; initial vote deadlocked 5-5 with one member absent, so the motion failed. Reintroduced in 2026 amid continued community pressure

item.title: Durham: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 60-day moratorium passed unanimously May 5, extended to 12 months on Jun 15. Covers data centers, data processing, and crypto mining. Council first amended the UDO to remove the local cap on moratorium length

item.title: Harnett County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause, unanimous; unincorporated areas. ~75 minutes of public comment with no speakers in favour of data centers. County Manager cited water/electricity consumption concerns

item.title: Cumberland County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month pause, 7-0; unincorporated areas only. Staff developing a data center ordinance with town halls in Aug and draft in Sep. Does not reach proposals seeking annexation into Fayetteville

item.title: Fayetteville: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Moratorium motion failed 5-5 on Aug 10; council voted 7-3 to pursue regulatory ordinance revisions instead, targeted for late Oct 2026. Cumberland County's 6-month moratorium covers unincorporated areas but not the city

item.title: Waxhaw: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, unanimous; covers data centers, crypto mining, and related digital infrastructure. Preemptive — no proposals pending

item.title: Statesville: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 180-day moratorium passed first reading; second reading scheduled Sep 14, 2026. No new data centers planned but city has received inquiries and the UDC does not address data centers

item.title: Asheville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium covering all data centers regardless of size. City drafting zoning laws. Intensive impacts on local electric and water utilities, noise, and heat

item.title: Wendell: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium through Dec 31, 2026. Preemptive — no data center applications filed. Pause for leaders to learn about impacts

item.title: Farmville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on data-center development, approved unanimously by the town's Board of Commissioners to allow staff time to research impacts and draft ordinance language, after East Energy Renewables (headquartered in Farmville) pitched a data-center network to town leaders in February.

item.title: Holly Springs: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year pause on data center construction

item.title: Greensboro: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Council voted 5-4 on Jul 21 against even starting the moratorium process, then reversed course and set a public hearing on a 120-day pause for facilities above 10 MW. Nothing is in effect yet
